text:
leila_cs: Quick heads-up — OrchidHealth onboarding flagged a latency SLO gap in the kickoff notes. Customer is asking if they'll get credits and we need an evidence bundle for renewal discussions. Can we triage and assemble comms/runbook?
ajay_infra: Can you drop the observed window + metric IDs? I can pull the dashboards and raw values.
leila_cs: Observed window 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07. Route: /generate. Observed p99 ~780ms across that week, contract SLO is p99 <= 500ms monthly. Customer wants clarity on credits. Need: final p99 calc, deploy timeline, incident notes, and a customer-facing explanation + credit calc example.
sam_oncall: On it — I also saw a deploy on 2026-06-02 03:40 UTC that coincides with the spike. Pulling logs now. Query I'll run:
```
SELECT quantile(0.99, latency_ms) as p99
FROM requests
WHERE route='/generate' AND dataset='orchid-prod'
AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-07'
GROUP BY day
```
ajay_infra: Running the same against our timeseries. Quick note — after the rollback the p99 dropped back under 500ms (around 490ms). Will attach graph when ready: https://grafana.redwood/osc/orchid/p99?range=7d
dev-bot: Deploy bot: Rollout orchid-service v2.14.3 completed 2026-06-02T03:40Z
katie_success_manager: Thanks. I'll draft the customer-facing note once we confirm numbers and credit amount. Do we want to include the deploy as context or just state measured impact + remediation?
leila_cs: Keep customer comms focused on impact and remediation, not internal RCA. Template artifacts we need to attach: dashboard link, raw query + csv, deploy timeline, incident summary, and a short customer impact statement.
ajay_infra: Confirmed — attaching raw CSV of per-minute p99 from 6/1-6/7: https://redwood-files/ops/orchid/p99-6-1-6-7.csv. Final aggregated monthly p99 for June window (prelim) = 780ms peak day, median days within month below SLA.
nora_finance: For credits we use pro-rata days-out formula by default. Send the invoice amount and the exact days that exceeded SLA; finance will compute dollar credit using our standard matrix and approve. We can also approve up to a 10% goodwill credit if CS requests business justification.
katie_success_manager: I'll prepare the draft email and the credit calc example. Draft link for review: https://docs.redwood/briefs/orchid-slo-credit-draft — comments welcome.
sam_oncall: Creating incident export and timeline: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260602/export — includes pager timeline, mitigations, and postmortem stub.
leila_cs: Proposed credit calc to present to customer: (days_out / 30) * monthly_fee * credit_factor. We'll show the numeric example using their June invoice. Keep goodwill offers separate and mark as negotiable.
katie_success_manager: Q for finance: do we need legal sign-off to publish the credit amount or is finance+CS sufficient?
nora_finance: Finance + CS is fine for the initial credit calculation and comms. Legal only for non-standard contract changes.
leila_cs: Action items: ajay_infra — finalize p99 numbers + attach raw query and CSV. sam_oncall — attach incident export and short timeline. katie_success_manager — draft customer note + runbook (include artifacts list). nora_finance — confirm credit amount using our matrix. I will consolidate and send to the customer by EOD Friday unless objections.
ajay_infra: Will post final p99 table and raw query in this thread by noon.
sam_oncall: I'll drop the incident notes and ID list here in 30m.
katie_success_manager: Draft updated — moved remediation wording to non-technical section and added a short FAQ about credits. Link: https://docs.redwood/briefs/orchid-slo-credit-draft (please review).
leila_cs: Reminder: do NOT include internal config diffs or blame in customer-facing text. Stick to observable impact and mitigation steps (we rolled back the rollout and adjusted autoscale).
katie_success_manager: Understood. One more ask — should we proactively offer a goodwill discount? Customer is mid-size and showing renewal risk.
nora_finance: We can pre-approve up to 10% goodwill; require CS rationale and executive approval path.
leila_cs: Let's present the formulaic credit first. If renewal discussions become difficult, CS can escalate goodwill with a short rationale.
dev-bot: Incident bot: Incident INC-20260602-ortk created (severity: S2) — assigned to sam_oncall
sam_oncall: Added incident export link above and attached logs. Will also include correlation of deploy -> p99 spike in the timeline.
katie_success_manager: I'll route the final draft to leila_cs and nora_finance for sign-off before sending. Target: EOD Friday. Thanks everyone.
leila_cs: :pray:
